description: Read a WhatsApp 'Export chat' (.txt, without media) and save the listings in it (trips, items for sale, services, jobs...) as entries that expire on their own date. Runs in the background: poll neuron_get_kb_import_status. Pro plan and up; charged to AI credits; reads at most the newest 1,000 messages from the last `sinceDays` days. The file itself is never stored. One import per organization at a time.

filePath.description: Path to the exported .txt on this machine (use this or text)

instructions.description: What counts as a listing in this group, in plain words

keepDays.description: How long a listing with no date stays valid after it was posted (default 14)

sinceDays.description: Only read messages from the last N days (default 30)

text.description: The exported chat text (use this or filePath)

name: neuron_import_whatsapp_chat
title: Import WhatsApp Chat Into Knowledge Base
